set.body:
Outcome

Represent runwise or partitionwise experimental-neural estimates with exact identities and capabilities.

Acceptance

- Every partition key maps to exactly one relation with exact effect and neural axes.
- Fit receipt records source revision, design, estimability, preparation, and training samples.
- Residual moments, precision, degrees of freedom, and estimability are typed capabilities rather than optional fields.
- Naked position-indexed relation vectors cannot cross the binder.
set.title: P4B.1: implement partition-bound Relation and PartitionedRelations evidence
